cards.answer: Cho'Gath is a tank and mage. He disrupts enemies with knockups, slows and silence, deals magic damage with his basic abilities, and uses Feast for true damage and permanent health growth.
cards.counterplay: Dodge Rupture, avoid his scream cone, and keep your distance when low on health.

cards.answer: Rupture erupts at a target location after a delay, dealing magic damage and knocking enemies up, then slowing them on landing. Its animation is visible in brush and fog of war.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the targeted area before it erupts; watch for it around brush.

cards.counterplay: Avoid standing in the spike path behind his attack target and kite away from his empowered attacks.

cards.answer: Feast deals true damage to a targeted enemy, scaling with AP and bonus health. A kill grants a permanent Feast stack that adds health, attack range and size; stacks from minions and non-epic monsters are limited.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance when low on health and retreat before he can approach for Feast.
